_source: Official one-page scanned Saginaw Control cutout-pattern sheet, visually reviewed at 150 DPI. It lists P-R2-F3R3-U450, P-Q7-F3R3-U450, P-Q9-F3R3-U450, P-B15-F3R3-U450, P-D4-H3R3-U450, P-R2-K3RF3-U450 and similar variants; it does not print P-P11R2-K3RF0-U450. Its dimensions therefore cannot be assigned to the requested product.
_tier: value-verified negative. OCR is allowed to read the drawing, but no product field may be inferred without the target catalog identity.

_notes.scope: This fixture deliberately protects refusal-to-guess, not a missing product fact. A future positive OCR table fixture needs its requested SKU visibly printed in the scanned source before it may assert a value.
